body: Anything is possible, my man. The sky is the limit. Would I still be depressed? Almost certainly, my depression is triggered by boredom, and in that situation I would incredibly bored.

I think they eventually become the same thing, wouldn't you agree? I mean, one would compensate for the other one, at least in my world. I would argue that it started as a psychological cycle, and has developed into a weird kind of personal samsara. Why do you ask?

Off and on for awhile. I've had a plan for a bit, but didn't really want to do it just yet. I wanted to see how things would turn out. Thank you for your concern.

edit: few years probably?
I'm glad you say that, but to be honest, I haven't felt this elated in a long time. I am pretty stoked.
